messages:
paul (billing): FYI — Card on file for Meridian Bio (acct_3302) declined 3x during scheduled charge for INV-2027-042. Customer asked to pay by wire to avoid suspension. Can we send wire block and confirm if we can waive the late fee? @anya?

payments-bot: payment_attempt_failed: 3 attempts (2027-01-09T09:02:11Z, 09:14:23Z, 09:31:07Z) -> decline_code: issuer_declined; processor_msg: processing_error

rita (acct-mgr): Invoice $5,400 due 2027-01-10. Their AP said the issuer flagged the payment; they'll initiate an outbound wire this morning. They asked whether Redwood will cover intermediary fees.

sam (treasury): Treasury checklist: require MT103 or bank confirmation. We do not automatically reimburse intermediary fees. For one-off emergency wires for mid-market customers we can credit up to $100 on receipt of MT103 showing fees. Originator bank must match KYC or provide AP verification.

anya (finance): Finance can approve waiving the $40 late fee if (1) proof of wire initiation is received within 24h and (2) funds post within 4 business days. Compliance must confirm origin bank match.

compliance-bot: compliance_check: if originator bank != KYC -> require AP email + bank statement (last 3 months) OR live AP verification call. MT103 may fast-track.

paul (billing): Wire block for customer email (paste below):

Bank: Summit National Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: 7700112233
Routing (ABA): 061000227
SWIFT: SNBKUS33
Reference: INV-2027-042 / Meridian Bio (acct_3302)

Please ask the payer to include the invoice reference exactly and reply with MT103 or a screenshot of the transfer confirmation to billing@redwood.ai.

rita (acct-mgr): Sending email now with instructions and this line: "We will hold suspension for 48 hours pending receipt of payment confirmation; once treasury confirms funds we will mark INV-2027-042 as paid and apply any agreed waivers."

sam (treasury): Operational note: if wire arrives net of intermediary fees, treasury will post the net amount. If customer requests reimbursement, include MT103 showing fees and we'll credit up to $100 per wire.

paul (billing): Moving INV-2027-042 to 'awaiting wire'. Tagging treasury & compliance for monitoring. :white_check_mark:
